'''Pickled zog''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], supplies of pickled zog were loaded aboard the ''[[Imru Ootmian]]'', a [[Yacht/Legends|space yacht]] that was owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]].
